summary: Patriot National Bancorp filed an 8-K disclosing entry into indemnification agreements with directors and addenda to employment agreements with certain officers, amending severance and change-of-control provisions. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. These are routine corporate governance and compensatory arrangements, not a special situation.
